controles.affirmation: Le retour au profit du deuxieme trimestre doit surtout a un versement exceptionnel lie au litige Nova Chemicals (hook) / une partie de cette amelioration provient de credits d'impot etrangers
controles.verbatim_source: Income (loss) before income taxes $871 / $(659) ; Provision for income taxes $69 / $142 ; Net sales $12,092 / $10,104. 'The provision for income taxes for the three months ended June 30, 2026 was favorably impacted by changes in the Company's ability to utilize foreign tax credits associated with cash proceeds received in March 2026 related to the Nova Chemicals Corporation ethylene asset matter, partially offset by tax charges related to changes in uncertain tax positions.' (10-Q T2 2026, Note 6)
controles.correction_proposee: Le basculement au profit se produit AVANT impot : le resultat avant impot passe de -659 M$ a +871 M$ (+1 530 M$), porte par un chiffre d'affaires en hausse de 1 988 M$. L'effet Nova ne concerne que la ligne d'impot, dont la charge ne baisse que de 142 a 69 M$. Reformuler : 'le taux d'impot du trimestre (7,9%) a ete allege par des credits d'impot etrangers lies au dossier Nova Chemicals', sans en faire la cause du retour au profit.

controles.affirmation: Un besoin en fonds de roulement favorable (comptes fournisseurs +1 347 M$, creances clients -1 761 M$) contribue a l'amelioration du resultat net
controles.verbatim_source: Changes in assets and liabilities ... Accounts and notes receivable (1,761) (935) ; Accounts payable 1,347 (12) — Six Months Ended Jun 30, 2026 / 2025, tableau des flux de tresorerie du 10-Q. Bilan : creances clients 6 430 (30/06/2026) contre 4 762 (31/12/2025).
controles.correction_proposee: Double erreur : (1) le (1 761) est une SORTIE de tresorerie (les creances clients augmentent de 1 668 M$), donc un effet DEFAVORABLE de BFR et non favorable ; (2) ces lignes sont des flux de tresorerie semestriels, sans effet sur le resultat net trimestriel. Supprimer cet element de l'argument ou le deplacer dans une analyse de tresorerie.

controles.affirmation: Deux degradations de notation de credit en six semaines
controles.verbatim_source: On February 18, 2026, Standard & Poor's announced a long-term credit rating change for TDCC from BBB to BBB- ... On February 27, 2026, Moody's Ratings announced a long-term credit rating change for TDCC from Baa2 to Baa3 (10-Q T2 2026, section Credit Ratings)
controles.correction_proposee: Les deux degradations sont separees de neuf jours (18 et 27 fevrier 2026), pas de six semaines. Ecrire 'deux degradations en neuf jours' (ce qui renforce d'ailleurs l'argument).

controles.affirmation: Le volume consolide recule de 2% sur un an, tire vers le bas par Industrial Intermediates & Infrastructure, explicitement rattache par Dow au conflit au Moyen-Orient — preuve citee : 'Volume decreased 2% year-over-year, driven by declines in Industrial Intermediates Infrastructure, which was impacted by the Middle East conflict'
controles.verbatim_source: Volume decreased 1 percent compared with the second quarter of 2025 and was mixed by operating segment; Packaging & Specialty Plastics (down 4 percent), Industrial Intermediates & Infrastructure (down 2 percent) and Performance Materials & Coatings (up 6 percent). Volume increased in Latin America (up 9 percent) and in the U.S. & Canada (up 3 percent) and was more than offset by a decrease in Asia Pacific (down 9 percent) and EMEAI (down 4 percent). (10-Q T2 2026, Overview) — la phrase citee comme verbatim est introuvable dans le 10-Q et dans le 8-K du 23 juillet 2026 present au data-lake.
controles.correction_proposee: Le volume CONSOLIDE recule de 1%, pas de 2% ; le -2% est le volume du seul segment Industrial Intermediates & Infrastructure. Le recul consolide est attribue par Dow a l'Asie-Pacifique (-9%) et a EMEAI (-4%), et le plus fort recul par segment est Packaging & Specialty Plastics (-4%). Le lien avec le conflit au Moyen-Orient existe mais au niveau du segment III uniquement : 'Volume decreased in Polyurethanes & Construction Chemicals, primarily in Asia Pacific and EMEAI due to the impact of the Middle East conflict'. Remplacer le faux verbatim par celui-ci.

controles.affirmation: La direction presente la baisse du dividende comme une mesure de preservation du bilan pendant le plan de restructuration
controles.verbatim_source: La section 'Dividends' du 10-Q T2 2026 se borne a : 'Dow Inc. has paid dividends on a quarterly basis since the separation from DowDuPont and expects to continue to do so, subject to approval by the Board', suivie du tableau des dividendes declares (0,35 $ les 12 fevrier et 9 avril 2026). Aucune justification de la reduction n'y figure.
controles.correction_proposee: Supprimer l'attribution a la direction, ou sourcer explicitement le communique du T4 2025 / la conference de resultats concernee, absents des sources citees.

controles.affirmation: L'objectif affiche est une amelioration d'au moins 2 Mds$ d'Operating EBITDA d'ici fin 2027
controles.verbatim_source: Transform to Outperform is expected to deliver at least $2 billion near-term Operating EBITDA improvement from productivity improvements and growth ... The actions, which include a workforce reduction of approximately 4,500 roles, are expected to be substantially complete by the end of 2027.
controles.correction_proposee: Le document parle d'une amelioration 'near-term' sans date ; c'est l'ACHEVEMENT DES ACTIONS qui est prevu fin 2027. Ne pas presenter fin 2027 comme l'echeance de l'objectif de 2 Mds$.

controles.verbatim_source: Dividends declared per share of common stock $0.35 $0.70 $0.70 $1.40 ; Dividends paid to stockholders (505) (990)

controles.affirmation: Plan Transform to Outperform approuve le 26 janvier 2026, environ 4 500 suppressions de postes, 472 M$ de charges avant impots (27 M$ au T1, 445 M$ au T2), 190 M$ d'Operating EBITDA livres au S1
controles.verbatim_source: On January 26, 2026, the Dow Inc. Board of Directors approved Transform to Outperform ... a workforce reduction of approximately 4,500 roles ... the Company recorded pretax charges of $27 million and $445 million, respectively ... pretax inception-to-date charges of $472 million ... In the first half of 2026, the Company delivered $190 million in Operating EBITDA improvement from Transform to Outperform.
controles.correction_proposee: Nuance conservatrice : les 472 M$ ne couvrent que les indemnites de depart ; le total des elements significatifs Transform to Outperform s'eleve a 606 M$ sur le semestre (dont 134 M$ de 'costs to achieve').

controles.verbatim_source: Fitch Ratings BBB F2 Stable ; Moody's Ratings Baa3 P-3 Negative ; Standard & Poor's BBB- A-3 Negative (au 30 juin 2026) + les deux annonces datees. On March 16, 2026, Fitch Ratings affirmed TDCC's BBB and F2 rating, with its outlook remaining stable.
